aions_core/AIONS_ULTIMATE_UNIFIED.py: This is the master integration system that combines all AIONS components into a single unified interface. It loads various subsystems including CBMS memory, Korean compression engine, CRLA tournament system, facts repository, conversation enhancement, and math solvers. The system provides query processing with fallback mechanisms, benchmarking capabilities, and state management across multiple memory sources. It includes interactive chat mode and comprehensive testing infrastructure to validate the integrated system's performance and reliability.
aions_core/agi_neural_backprop.py: This file implements a neural network architecture for differential reasoning using PyTorch. It contains classes for knowledge embedding, differentiable memory with read-write operations, and a reasoning graph with multi-hop attention mechanisms. The system supports gradient-based learning through backpropagation, enables checkpoint saving and loading, and analyzes gradient flow to detect training issues. It processes knowledge chunks and queries through learnable neural layers to produce reasoned outputs with confidence scores.
aions_core/aions_monitoring_dashboard.py: This is a comprehensive monitoring and testing suite for the AIONS system. It performs health checks on various components, runs test suites with specific categories, conducts performance benchmarking, and generates detailed monitoring reports. The file tracks response times, test results, error logs, and component status. It measures success rates across different test categories like core functionality, vector search, and hybrid retrieval, then saves metrics and generates reports.
aions_core/api.py: This file provides a FastAPI web interface for the AIONS system. It initializes the unified core with vector, hybrid retrieval, agent, style, and monitoring components enabled. The API exposes endpoints for querying the system and checking health status. It implements offline mode for transformers to avoid network calls, and includes error handling for cases where the kernel fails to initialize.
aions_core/memory_graph_engine.py: This file builds and maintains a knowledge graph that maps relationships between concepts. It loads concept nodes, edges, and weighted connections from a JSON file, then provides methods to expand queries through related concepts, find concept clusters, and suggest tags based on content. It integrates with CBMS retrieval to enhance searches by expanding queries with semantically related concepts and filtering results by connectivity and weight thresholds.
aions_core/server/cbms_symbolic_index.py: This file creates a symbolic index over CBMS codes derived from chunk content. It converts each knowledge chunk to Esperanto, encodes it using a codebook to generate CBMS symbols, and builds a reverse index mapping symbols to chunk identifiers. The index enables fast retrieval by querying chunks based on their symbolic representation without modifying the original chunk files.
aions_core/server/esperanto_bridge.py: This file provides lightweight text normalization from Polish and English to Esperanto for symbolic processing. It implements deterministic mappings for common phrases and domain-specific terms related to CBMS and reasoning systems. The system normalizes whitespace, converts recognized words to Esperanto representations, and includes reverse mapping for demonstration purposes. It avoids heavy dependencies and is designed for safe, expandable symbolic encoding.
aions_core/server/pocket_qc.py: This quality control system validates text and CRLA results by checking for malicious patterns and ensuring symbolic content coverage. It verifies that text passes logic checks and encodes to a sufficient number of CBMS symbols. For CRLA results, it examines winner scores, determinism ratings, and refusal status to assign pass/retry/fail verdicts. All results are logged to a JSONL file for audit purposes.
aions_core/test_aions_capabilities.py: This file runs comprehensive conversational capability tests across six categories: personal conversation, philosophical reasoning, emotional intelligence, creative tasks, ethical boundaries, and self-awareness. It sends queries to an HTTP API endpoint, collects responses with latency metrics, and analyzes success rates by checking for refusals and content length. It generates a detailed assessment report documenting the system's conversational strengths and weaknesses.
aions_core/tools/gsm8k_quick.py: This script evaluates math problem-solving performance using the GSM8K dataset. It reads test questions from a JSONL file, sends them to a chat API, and extracts numeric answers using multiple regex patterns. It calculates accuracy, tracks refusals, and computes percentile latency metrics (p50, p95). Results are output as JSON with counts and performance statistics.
aions_core/tools/test_guardrail.py: This file tests the guardrail refusal policy of the system. It sends two HTTP requests: a nonsense query that should be refused and a valid query that should be accepted. It displays the response status and JSON result for each test to verify the system correctly identifies and handles out-of-distribution inputs versus legitimate questions.
control_plane/agents/agent_registry.py: This file implements a plugin-based agent registry that automatically discovers agent definitions from folders containing agent.json files. Agents are loaded into memory with full validation against a schema. The registry provides methods to retrieve agents by ID, list all available IDs, and report discovery errors. It follows the same automatic discovery pattern as the skill registry.
control_plane/blends/search_blends.py: This command-line tool provides offline keyword search across a library of knowledge blends stored as JSON. It queries the blend library by keywords and returns matching results ranked by relevance score. Results can be output as JSON or formatted text showing blend IDs, domains, and relevant rule conclusions. It supports limiting results and detailed metadata retrieval.
control_plane/llm_adapter.py: This file adapts local LLM models (Ollama or OpenAI) to speak within the AIONS system, injecting context from the operator profile and CBMS memory. It builds prompts with system instructions in Polish, retrieves relevant knowledge chunks, and manages different model tiers (small/large). It includes sophisticated context management, handles both HTTP and subprocess-based LLM backends, and implements graceful fallback when models are unavailable.
control_plane/operator/loop.py: This is the main operational control loop for the AIONS system implementing observe-diagnose-act-verify-learn cycles. It monitors system health by checking disk usage, service status, memory, and log errors against rolling baselines. The loop applies deterministic rules to generate actions, enforces restart cooldowns to prevent thrashing, logs incidents with optional LLM commentary, and supports both one-shot and continuous watch modes with graceful shutdown.
control_plane/skills/__init__.py: This file documents the skills engine unified object model and subsystem architecture for AIONS. It indicates the file is part of a larger skill execution framework with components for planning, execution, recipe management, and decision-making.
control_plane/skills/goal_planner.py: This file implements goal planning using a small local LLM (Phi-4-mini) to select skills from a constrained catalog. The planner uses a two-level cache system: exact recipe matches and CBMS-based skill chain retrieval before calling the LLM. It validates all LLM-generated plans against known skills, filters out hallucinated values and placeholders, logs cache decisions, and either executes the plan or escalates to a larger model.
control_plane/skills/schema.py: This file defines the unified object model for AIONS with a single AObject type that can represent knowledge, skills, recipes, workflows, decisions, thinking patterns, failures, and successes. Objects have metadata like risk level, inputs/outputs, preconditions, and handlers. The schema includes validation rules and supports both executable skills and composite recipes with step sequences.
mcpServers/VS_CODE_MCP_CODEX/src/__main_: This is the entry point for the AIONS context MCP server that connects to VS Code. It validates that Python runs in the project venv, configures the system path, and handles transport selection (stdio, HTTP, SSE). On Windows, it uses patched stdio handling to avoid binary mode issues with JSON-RPC. It supports both local and LAN modes with configurable host binding and DNS rebinding protection.
mcpServers/VS_CODE_MCP_CODEX/src/provide: This file manages platform-native search and desktop backends for the AIONS system. It provides functions to select filesystem search providers (Linux index or Windows Everything), configure Linux indexing with auto-refresh, instantiate desktop providers (Windows primary, Linux native), and expose provider capabilities for health checks and documentation.
scripts/aions_python.sh: This bash script is a launcher that resolves and executes Python from the correct AIONS venv. It reads configuration from .aions/python.env to determine the Python version and venv location, validates the venv exists with matching version, and either executes Python scripts or just outputs the Python path. It includes modes to resolve Python, ensure venv exists, and export runtime configuration variables.
scripts/chatgpt_ultimate.py: This script extracts comprehensive data from ChatGPT Desktop cache files including user info, conversation titles, custom GPTs, draft messages, and model access information. It cleans corrupted spaced-out text patterns, parses JSON structures embedded in raw cache data, and generates both JSON and markdown reports. It handles special-encoded titles and produces a detailed extraction showing conversations, user metadata, and model capabilities.
scripts/demo_windows_final.py: This is a final Windows demonstration script showing the AIONS skill engine in action. It discovers the full skill library, performs a chain of three tasks (create folder, write file, zip contents), demonstrates learning by saving the recipe, then performs individual skill executions like opening folders, web search, system resource queries, volume control, and keyboard input. It ends with statistics on skill usage and success rates.
scripts/operator_daily_brief.py: This script generates a morning briefing for the operator showing active cases, upcoming deadlines, goals, and recent decisions from the operator profile. It includes optional system health checks and scheduler status. The brief summarizes status labels and priorities in Polish, displays information from the operator_profile.json, and can output formatted text or JSON. It serves as a proactive dashboard for daily planning.
scripts/set_aions_cache_env.sh: This bash script configures environment variables for AIONS development cache directories, all pointing to D: drive (avoiding slower C: and network E:). It sets up paths for pip cache, temporary files, HuggingFace models, PyTorch, Docker config, and other tool caches. All directories are created if missing, organizing development dependencies in a single cache root.
scripts/test_llm_adapter.py: This functional test verifies that the LLM adapter correctly integrates local models (Ollama) with context injection. It checks health status of Ollama, then queries the system with Polish questions designed to verify: operator profile injection (name recognition), CBMS context usage (technical concepts), and Polish language responses. It validates token throughput and latency metrics.
scripts/vault/_core.py: This file implements a Windows DPAPI-based local secrets vault for AIONS with no external KMS. It stores encrypted blobs under runtime/secrets/vault/ using CurrentUser encryption scope. It provides functions to seal files with encryption, open vault entries for decryption, manage operator markers for access control, and maintain a JSON index of stored secrets. Fallback to PowerShell handles cases where ctypes fails.
server/app.py: This file defines the FastAPI knowledge server application providing REST endpoints for context management, semantic search, session operations, and dashboard summaries. It initializes ChromaDB via the store_selector module and adds CORS middleware for cross-origin requests. The API supports batch ingestion, similarity search with metadata filtering, session statistics, pruning expired entries, and optionally includes control plane routes.
server/store_selector.py: This module automatically selects between HTTP and embedded ChromaDB based on environment configuration or auto-detection. It checks CHROMA_USE_HTTP environment variable first; if set to auto, it attempts HTTP connection and falls back to embedded mode. It provides a unified VectorStore interface regardless of backend, enabling the knowledge server to work flexibly in both network and standalone configurations.
